remarks: Charming 3-4 Bedroom Rental in Desirable Darien Water Community - $5,800/month  Welcome to this inviting 3-4 bedroom, 2 full bathroom home in a sought-after Darien water community. Perfect for families or anyone seeking a blend of comfort and coastal living, this well-maintained residence offers flexible space to suit your lifestyle.  The private, fenced-in backyard provides a safe haven for the family and pets to play, while also creating the perfect setting for outdoor dining and relaxation. Enjoy easy access to Holly Pond-just a short walk from your door-where you can embrace the waterfront lifestyle that makes Darien so special.  This home combines practical living spaces with the lifestyle you've been dreaming of, all in one of Fairfield County's most desirable communities
